outputs.description: Reproduced hydraulic fracture quantities: stress at two crack‑tip points and maximum crack opening for three water pressure levels. The checker compares these values to hidden paper‑reported gold data with appropriate tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The agent must re-implement the coupled Biot-smeared crack simulation; the outputs are expected to match the paper's Table 3 within tolerances that account for legitimate implementation differences. No gold values are revealed here.
